title: Miniatures (2011)
summary: Miniatures are a line of collectible Titan minifigures and Amulets released by Giochi Preziosi in 2011, based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. Measuring 6cm in height, the line was a successor to the 2009 line released by Tridimensional but now featured a variety of different Titans as opposed to just specific Titan types. As a new feature, each Titan figure was imprinted with its Icon that was only visible under the UV light of one of the Amulet keyrings, operated by pressing its gem.

sections.heading: Release
sections.wikitext:
The Season 2 miniatures were sold across Europe in small see-through sachets, each containing a Titan or Amulet and a game card containing the Titan's info and a collector's leaflet. There were 6 Amulets and 18 Titans to collect from this initial wave. 

12 figures were released in green packaging with 6 of them being exclusive figures that were only available in Italy. These figure each included a [[Fanbook]] (''Fanbuk'' in Italian), a small booklet containing a Titan biography and information on a historical legend.

full_text:
Miniatures are a line of collectible Titan minifigures and Amulets released by Giochi Preziosi in 2011, based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. Measuring 6cm in height, the line was a successor to the 2009 line released by Tridimensional but now featured a variety of different Titans as opposed to just specific Titan types. As a new feature, each Titan figure was imprinted with its Icon that was only visible under the UV light of one of the Amulet keyrings, operated by pressing its gem. 

== Release == 
The Season 2 miniatures were sold across Europe in small see-through sachets, each containing a Titan or Amulet and a game card containing the Titan's info and a collector's leaflet. There were 6 Amulets and 18 Titans to collect from this initial wave. 

12 figures were released in green packaging with 6 of them being exclusive figures that were only available in Italy. These figure each included a Fanbook (Fanbuk in Italian), a small booklet containing a Titan biography and information on a historical legend.
